summary: Temporary keyless cross-account access (AWS STS + GCP Workload Identity) for analytics sandbox
description:
Issue summary:
Requesting a timebound, keyless cross-account access path for the Data Analytics team to run ad-hoc queries and ETL validation against the analytics sandbox. The team needs both AWS and GCP access so their pipelines can read from a cross-account S3 bucket and write processed results into a GCS bucket.

Impact:
Without this access, analysts cannot validate new dataset ingestion and transformation logic against realistic data. This is blocking a scheduled release validation window (internal milestone: ANALYTICS-2026-Q1).

Requested duration:
7 days from first-use; intended to be used by 2 engineers (A. Chen, R. Patel).

Requested access pattern and constraints (security preferences):
- No long-lived service account keys or static AWS access keys.
- AWS: Assume an IAM role via STS (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/analytics-temp-assumerole) using external-id and session tags. Session should be limited to max 8 hours per session. Permission boundary should restrict to read-only on s3:analytics-sandbox-* and kms:Decrypt on key alias/analytics-sbox.
- GCP: Use Workload Identity Federation from an internal identity pool or a short-lived service account impersonation (no JSON keys persisted). Grant roles/storage.objectViewer on projects/analytics-sandbox and roles/storage.objectCreator on a single target GCS bucket.
- MFA and JIT approval where possible (via Okta push or Slack approval) for sessions > 4 hours.

Deliverables requested from infra/security team:
1) Create the AWS assume-role with permission boundary and an explicit deny for iam:CreateAccessKey on relevant principals. Provide a sample assume-role command and an external-id workflow.
2) Provision a GCP service account that can be impersonated via Workload Identity Pool tied to Redwood SSO (no long-lived keys).
3) Document verification steps and an acceptance checklist for the requesters.
4) Audit logging enabled with a retention check and a link to relevant logs/dashboards.

Additional context:
- The analytics sandbox is hosted in a dedicated project/account separate from prod workloads. Data is pseudonymized but still treated as internal.
- Team prefers CLI flows and a scripted helper that will request and return temporary credentials.
- Compliance request: security team wants session tags including requester email and ticket ID for traceability.
steps_to_validate_access:
1) For AWS: run "aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/analytics-temp-assumerole --role-session-name analyst-session --external-id <EXT-ID> --duration-seconds 28800" then use the returned creds to run "aws s3 ls s3://analytics-sandbox-raw/ --no-sign-request".
2) For GCP: use gcloud auth login (SSO) then run "gcloud iam service-accounts impersonate SERVICE_ACCOUNT --project=analytics-sandbox --duration=3600" (internal helper expected), then "gsutil ls gs://analytics-sandbox-processed/".
3) Verify session tags in CloudTrail and GCP Audit Logs within 15 minutes of first assume.
investigation_notes: Initial review (2026-03-10): sandbox accounts are isolated; no existing workload-identity pool mapped for analytics team. Existing AWS role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/analytics-readonly exists but allows broader S3 prefixes; needs narrowing.
Security constraints: deny long-lived keys; require permission boundary and explicit deny for iam:CreateAccessKey; require session tagging for ticket correlation.

Suggested AWS policy snippet (permission boundary) as a single-line string: "{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::analytics-sandbox-*","arn:aws:s3:::analytics-sandbox-*/*"]},{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":["arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcdef12-3456-7890-abcd-ef1234567890"]}] }"

Suggested GCP binding: grant roles/storage.objectViewer on project:analytics-sandbox to serviceAccount:analytics-temp@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com; add IAM Condition limiting to buckets analytics-sandbox-processed and analytics-sandbox-raw.
Operational note: add an automated scheduled job to revoke any unused temporary roles after 7 days and rotate any related metadata; ensure logging to the security audit project.

Aisha Patel - Security (2026-03-11): Prefer dynamic external-id tied to ticket ID. Also require session_tag: {"ticket":"INT-412345","user":"<email>"}. Deny CreateAccessKey must be explicit in policy.
Marco Nguyen (2026-03-11): Dynamic external-id is fine. Team confirms two users: a.chen@redwood.com, r.patel@redwood.com. They will use the infra helper script.
Sofia Ramirez (2026-03-12): Draft role created in staging. Waiting on security review for permission boundary. Created PR: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/7890.
